scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays product name, tagline, and value proposition prominently as specified in REQ-1 and US-1

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: User lands on the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains the product name 'MirDB', tagline about Memcached protocol support, and value proposition
steps.context: Hero section should be visible in the first viewport without scrolling

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' primary CTA and 'View on GitHub' secondary CTA buttons are present and visible
steps.context: CTAs should be prominent and accessible

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is displayed prominently in the hero section
Tagline mentions 'persistent key-value store' and 'Memcached protocol support'
'Get Started' button is visible and clickable in the hero section
'View on GitHub' button is visible and links to GitHub repository

test_cases.input: Check hero section visibility without scrolling
test_cases.expected: Hero section with key messaging is visible in the first viewport on desktop

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that key features are presented clearly as specified in REQ-2 including persistence, Memcached compatibility, LSM tree architecture, and async Rust

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to the features section of the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be easily accessible from the hero section

steps.description: Check that all four key features are displayed with icons, titles, and descriptions
steps.context: Each feature should have visual distinction and clear explanation

test_cases.input: Inspect features section for Memcached Protocol Compatibility card
test_cases.expected: Feature card for Memcached Protocol Compatibility is displayed with icon, title, and description

test_cases.input: Inspect features section for Persistent Storage card
test_cases.expected: Feature card for Persistent Storage with SSTables is displayed with icon, title, and description

test_cases.input: Inspect features section for LSM Tree Architecture card
test_cases.expected: Feature card for LSM Tree Architecture is displayed with icon, title, and description

test_cases.input: Inspect features section for Async Rust card
test_cases.expected: Feature card for Async Rust with Tokio is displayed with icon, title, and description

test_cases.input: Check 3-4 features visible in first viewport after hero
test_cases.expected: At least 3 key feature highlights are visible within first scroll on desktop
